title: bryonia cretica subsp. marmorata
intro: Bryonia cretica subsp. marmorata, commonly known as the marble bryony, is a plant species in the Cucurbitaceae family, native to the Balkan Peninsula. The health benefits of Bryonia cretica subsp. marmorata include its anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which make it useful in treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The therapeutic actions of this plant include stimulating digestion, reducing fever, and alleviating rheumatic pain. The bioactive constituents of Bryonia cretica subsp. marmorata include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
